name: Inomata Haruhiko
source:
Inomata is a hot-headed and rash member of the special forces. 
He often disobeys or questions orders, and places himself in danger. 
He dislikes [url=/c80097]Akira[/url], considering him "frigid" due to his suppressed emotions. 
[Spoiler]After the mission at Cauliflower, he began to doubt his abilities. He is close to [url=/c163257]Sakamoto Kenichi[/url], and put himself in danger to avenge him.[/spoiler] 

[Description from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Haruhiko_Inomata]Wiki[/url]]
